# xbintsc

> xbintsc compiles a subset of TypeScript directly to native binaries: it parses
> TypeScript itself, lowers the program to LLVM IR text, and drives clang to
> produce a standalone executable linked against a small C runtime. There is no
> Node.js, V8 or TypeScript compiler inside the produced binary. An optional
> `gui` extension links a self-hosted, GPU-accelerated HTML/CSS renderer, so the
> same TypeScript can also build a native desktop application whose UI is
> HTML/CSS (no system WebView, no runtime JS engine). It runs on
> macOS, Linux and Windows (x64 and arm64), compiles itself, and ships prebuilt
> archives per platform. A clang 16+ toolchain is required to link binaries;
> `xbintsc emit` (LLVM IR only) needs nothing.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/AGENTS.md): entry point for an agent working in the repository — what xbintsc is, the repository map, the build gate and the rules
- [doc/ai/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/ai/README.md): task-oriented AI guide — the three facts that decide everything, and which page to read for your task
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/README.md): the project's human overview

## Using the compiler

- [doc/ai/build-recipe.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/ai/build-recipe.md): exact commands to run, build, inspect IR and configure a project, with the program shape that compiles
- [doc/ai/cli.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/ai/cli.md): every CLI flag and its parsing quirks, project config fields, environment variables, incremental-cache behaviour, diagnostic codes, programmatic API
- [doc/ai/language-support.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/ai/language-support.md): the supported TypeScript subset as tables — statements, expressions, classes, async, the erased type system, standard library gaps, modules, runtime deviations
- [doc/support-matrix.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/support-matrix.md): generated support matrix — every row is backed by a corpus case that is compiled and compared with Node, or must fail with a documented diagnostic
- [doc/ai/extensions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/ai/extensions.md): Node built-in modules and the `--ext node` rule, the GUI extension, bundling third-party packages, C++/Rust native extensions via manifest
- [doc/ai/troubleshooting.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/ai/troubleshooting.md): the clang version requirement and every frequent error message with its cause and fix
- [doc/requirements.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/requirements.md): per-platform toolchain prerequisites
- [doc/xbintsc.config.schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/xbintsc.config.schema.json): JSON schema for `xbintsc.config.json`

## Changing the compiler

- [doc/ai/contributing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/ai/contributing.md): test suites, the self-hosting fixpoint invariant, the runtime ABI and value model, adding extensions or diagnostics, documentation duties
- [doc/DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/DESIGN.md): architecture and design rationale
- [doc/implemented.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented.md): index of everything implemented — one page per compiler stage / feature area
  - [doc/implemented/pipeline.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/pipeline.md): pipeline and self-hosting
  - [doc/implemented/lexer.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/lexer.md): tokens, literals and lexical diagnostics
  - [doc/implemented/parser.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/parser.md): statement, expression and type syntax
  - [doc/implemented/binder.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/binder.md): scopes, symbols and capture
  - [doc/implemented/checker.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/checker.md): the opt-out checker — names, redeclarations, arity, structural assignability, property shapes, simple generics and flow narrowing, and what it deliberately does not check
  - [doc/implemented/operators.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/operators.md): operators and assignment
  - [doc/implemented/value-model.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/value-model.md): NaN-boxing and the function ABI
  - [doc/implemented/codegen.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/codegen.md): LLVM IR lowering
  - [doc/implemented/runtime-core.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/runtime-core.md): allocator, values, exceptions
  - [doc/implemented/strings.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/strings.md): the string model and text codecs
  - [doc/implemented/stdlib.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/stdlib.md): Object/Array/Number/Math/JSON/Date/RegExp/Symbol/errors/console
  - [doc/implemented/collections.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/collections.md): Map/Set/WeakMap/WeakSet/WeakRef
  - [doc/implemented/typed-arrays.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/typed-arrays.md): typed arrays, ArrayBuffer and DataView
  - [doc/implemented/async.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/async.md): async/await, promises, generators and timers
  - [doc/implemented/fetch.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/fetch.md): the HTTP client
  - [doc/implemented/modules.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/modules.md): import/export and bundling
  - [doc/implemented/extensions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/extensions.md): the extension registry and the `node` extension
  - [doc/implemented/driver.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/driver.md): incremental cache, clang, LTO/PGO, config, icons
  - [doc/implemented/cli.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/cli.md): CLI and the embedder API
  - [doc/implemented/tests.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/tests.md): unit, e2e, differential harness and the executable conformance corpus
- [doc/unimplemented.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented.md): index of unsupported syntax, missing semantics and known deviations
  - [doc/unimplemented/statements.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/statements.md): statement gaps
  - [doc/unimplemented/expressions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/expressions.md): expression and operator gaps
  - [doc/unimplemented/stdlib.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/stdlib.md): standard-library gaps, including typed arrays
  - [doc/unimplemented/modules.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/modules.md): circular dependencies, live bindings, CommonJS boundaries
  - [doc/unimplemented/functions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/functions.md): function semantics
  - [doc/unimplemented/classes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/classes.md): class and OO gaps
  - [doc/unimplemented/types.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/types.md): the erased type system
  - [doc/unimplemented/deviations.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/deviations.md): runtime behaviour that differs from ECMAScript
  - [doc/unimplemented/toolchain.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/toolchain.md): toolchain, platform and engineering gaps
- [doc/implemented/node.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/implemented/node.md): Node extension — index, one page per Node module under `doc/implemented/node/`
- [doc/unimplemented/node.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/unimplemented/node.md): what the `node` extension is still missing — per-module and cross-cutting pages under `doc/unimplemented/node/`
- [doc/gui.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui.md): the self-hosted GPU HTML/CSS renderer — overview, architecture and roadmap
  - [doc/gui/api.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/api.md): the TypeScript window API, events and diagnostics hooks
  - [doc/gui/dom.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/dom.md): HTML/CSS parsing, the cascade, the interactive DOM and AOT scripts
  - [doc/gui/layout.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/layout.md): block, inline, Flexbox and CSS positioning
  - [doc/gui/rendering.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/rendering.md): the display list, SDL_GPU pipelines and the text stack
  - [doc/gui/media.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/media.md): images, SVG, video and audio
  - [doc/gui/input.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/input.md): hit testing, events and `:hover`/`:focus`
  - [doc/gui/animation.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/animation.md): `requestAnimationFrame` and CSS transitions
  - [doc/gui/runtime.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/runtime.md): event loop integration, the native bridge and memory
  - [doc/gui/build.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/build.md): building `gui.a` and running the examples
  - [doc/gui/known-issues.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui/known-issues.md): known issues and open questions
- [doc/gui-scripts.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/gui-scripts.md): the GUI scripting surface
- [doc/icon.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/doc/icon.md): application icons and project config packaging
- [examples/extensions/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zy445566/xbintsc/main/examples/extensions/README.md): authoring C++ and Rust native extensions
